newsitem.title: USA: Colo. police no longer looking at autopsy report.
newsitem.headline: Colo. police no longer looking at autopsy report.

text.p: Police investigating the murder of 6-year-old beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey said Friday said they were no longer looking into an autopsy report of her older half sister.
Elizabeth Ramsey, 22, died in an automobile accident on Jan. 8, 1992 in the Chicago area.
Boulder officials said Thursday the autopsy report had become part of its file, but declined to disclose why police were interested in the woman's death.
Boulder police released Elizabeth Ramsey's one-page autopsy report, which listed the cause of death as multiple injuries due to the accident.

JonBenet's body was found on Dec. 26 by her father, John Ramsey, in a windowless room in the basement of the family's home in Boulder. Eight hours earlier her mother, Patricia Ramsey, said she had found a ransom note demanding $118,000.
No suspects have been named and no arrests have beem made.
